description: This file defines buffer construction functions for PostgreSQL protocol message testing, providing specific message buffers for various protocol responses and requests in a testing context.

methods.name: readyForQuery
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating the server is ready for a query.

methods.name: authenticationOk
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating successful authentication.

methods.name: authenticationCleartextPassword
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating cleartext password authentication requested.

methods.name: authenticationMD5Password
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating MD5 password authentication with provided salt.

methods.name: authenticationSASL
methods.description: Creates a buffer for SASL authentication request.

methods.name: authenticationSASLContinue
methods.description: Creates a buffer for SASL continue message.

methods.name: authenticationSASLFinal
methods.description: Creates a buffer for SASL final message.

methods.name: parameterStatus
methods.description: Creates a buffer representing a parameter status message with name and value.

methods.name: backendKeyData
methods.description: Creates a buffer with backend process ID and secret key.

methods.name: commandComplete
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating command completion with a command tag string.

methods.name: rowDescription
methods.description: Creates a buffer describing row fields for a result set.

methods.name: parameterDescription
methods.description: Creates a buffer describing data types of columns in a result set.

methods.name: dataRow
methods.description: Creates a buffer representing a data row with column values.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates a buffer for error messages.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Creates a buffer for notice messages.

methods.name: errorOrNotice
methods.description: Creates a buffer for error or notice fields.

methods.name: parseComplete
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating parse completion.

methods.name: bindComplete
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating bind completion.

methods.name: notification
methods.description: Creates a buffer for a notification message with id, channel, and payload.

methods.name: emptyQuery
methods.description: Creates a buffer for an empty query.

methods.name: portalSuspended
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating portal suspension.

methods.name: closeComplete
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating close completion.

methods.name: copyIn
methods.description: Creates a buffer for initiating copy-in with specified columns.

methods.name: copyOut
methods.description: Creates a buffer for initiating copy-out with specified columns.

methods.name: copyData
methods.description: Creates a buffer carrying copy data bytes.

methods.name: copyDone
methods.description: Creates a buffer indicating copy is done.
